name: fullstack-template
description: A modern fullstack monorepo template with end-to-end type safety, designed for self-hosted deployment

scripts.dev:db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && pnpm dev:db && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.dev: pnpm dev:db && pnpm --filter @fullstack-template/shared build && pnpm db:migrate && turbo run dev
scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm type-check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.check: pnpm format && pnpm knip && pnpm validate
scripts.db:e2e:reset: docker exec -i $(docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml ps -q db) psql -U postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS fullstack_template_test' && docker exec -i $(docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml ps -q db) psql -U postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE fullstack_template_test' && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/fullstack_template_test pnpm db:migrate && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/fullstack_template_test BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-must-be-at-least-32-characters-long BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3001 NODE_ENV=test pnpm db:seed

comments.overrides.esbuild: Fixes GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 in drizzle-kit's deprecated @esbuild-kit dependency. Remove when drizzle-kit 1.0 stable releases.
